$comment: The release-candidate tag the compat CREDENTIAL lanes run against (ADR-0056). null = no RC cut yet: the credential crons refuse rather than test main. Cutting an RC is a founder action: push the vX.Y.Z-rc.N tag, then bump rcTag here in a reviewed PR. scripts/compat-credential-ref.mjs resolves it.
$rcBumpMarkerComment: #1302 — while rcTag is non-null, .github/workflows/compat-credential-freeze-guard.yml refuses any PR touching a file the credential harness executes (derived, see docs/ci/credential-freeze-guard.md), unless this object is ALSO present and unexpired: rcBumpMarker: { date: 'YYYY-MM-DD', expires: 'YYYY-MM-DD', reason: '...', paths?: ['exact/frozen/path', ...] }. #1635: a marker exempts only the PR that introduces it (absent at that PR's merge base, or a new date/reason); a marker inherited from main exempts nothing, and a pin-only PR that just removes or shortens the marker passes without one. #1641: a PR changing rcTag fails unless that tag already exists on the remote and is reachable from main.

rcBumpMarker.reason: Vinext self-contained empty-dir pre-check fix (#2615), applying the same scoped-marker rule as the earlier markers. Founder confirmed the original four paths (.github/compat-credential-ref.json, .github/workflows/compat-vinext.yml, scripts/e2e-deploy-vinext.sh, scripts/lib/e2e-empty-dir.sh) on 2026-11-02 and the two added paths (scripts/compat-window-audit.mjs, scripts/lib/e2e-verify-intentional-500.sh) on 2026-11-03. On integration/v2 only, compat-vinext.yml, scripts/e2e-deploy-vinext.sh and scripts/lib/e2e-empty-dir.sh change so the probe honours basePath and accepts a 5xx at / only for an explicit allowlist of three upstream fixtures that fail there on purpose; scripts/lib/e2e-verify-intentional-500.sh gates that allowlist, and scripts/compat-window-audit.mjs declares it in the bun-vinext lane extraFiles. The bun-vinext lane is wired false, so this change counts or resets no credential run there. The node and bun v1.0 lanes (wired true) DO hash scripts/lib/e2e-empty-dir.sh, scripts/e2e-deploy-vinext.sh and this pin file, so their fingerprints move when this merges. The earlier claim that no v1.0 credential fingerprint moves was wrong and is withdrawn. No published byte moves (this PR touches no packages/ file). rcTag is unchanged.

$publishedBytesBumpMarkerComment: #1663 — while rcTag is non-null, .github/workflows/published-bytes-freeze-guard.yml packs the publishable group at a PR's own merge ref and diffs it against the pinned rc tag's already-packed tarballs, unless this object is ALSO present and unexpired: publishedBytesBumpMarker: { date: 'YYYY-MM-DD', expires: 'YYYY-MM-DD', reason: '...' }. Same #1635 introduced-by-this-PR rule as rcBumpMarker. Remove once the pinned rcTag itself moves to the new rc (PR B, #1660).

publishedBytesBumpMarker.reason: Lead decision 2026-10-10 under the founder's 'don't block on me' direction, applying the same rule the founder-approved scoped markers established for X1 (#2076) and V1 (#2078). v2 X3 platform-layer P0, CLI half (#2096): minScale/maxScale are emitted only when set, which changes @getknext/core bytes on main. Main has carried the 1.3 line since X1. Credential runs pack from the v1.0.0-rc.6 tag checkout, not from main, so no v1.0 credential fingerprint moves.
